name: Spam Catcher » Self-spoofed sender >> Deleted Messages
comments: Cache.db analysis 2026-08-13: backscatter/self-impersonation spam. The From
address or display name claims to be the account holder (sj.gibson+<random>
plus-tag, or a bare 'Steve Gibson'/'sj.gibson' display name) from a domain
he doesn't own (hotmail.com, live.no, usal.es, sadricgroup.com,
172uL3.focusing.org). No genuine sender in this account uses a '+' tagged
plus-address, so the regex is safe without a broader allow-guard; the real
sj.gibson@ addresses are excluded explicitly anyway as a backstop.
2026-08-22: exclusion list was only 4 of the ~17 addresses this account actually
sends from (see rules/1767640961_me.json). Genuine mail sent from any of the
stephenjgibson@gmail.com) using a 'Steve Gibson'/'sj.gibson' display name to a
recipient outside the *ME allowlist was being wrongly deleted as spoofed spam --
this rule (priority 200) never gave *ME (priority 50) a chance to protect it since
*ME only matches when the recipient is also one of the account's own addresses.
Expanded the exclusion list to match the full address set.
